materials.label: cardboard
materials.name: Cardboard
materials.action: Keep it clean, dry and flat.
steps: Empty the box and separate any plastic liners or inserts.
Flatten clean, dry cardboard for easier collection.
Check local rules for food-soiled, waxed or coated packaging; acceptance varies.
materials.caution: A cardboard prediction cannot identify coatings or food contamination.

materials.label: glass
materials.name: Glass
materials.action: Check the type of glass first.
steps: Empty accepted bottles and jars; follow local instructions for rinsing and lids.
Keep ceramics, mirrors, light bulbs and window glass separate unless explicitly accepted.
Handle damaged glass carefully and follow your collector’s instructions for broken glass.
materials.caution: The model cannot confirm that an item is container glass or safe to handle.

materials.label: metal
materials.name: Metal
materials.action: Empty the container. Check special items.
steps: For accepted food or drink cans, empty the contents and follow local cleaning rules.
Check separately for foil, mixed-material packaging and sharp metal items.
Use appropriate collection services for batteries, electronics and pressurized containers.
materials.caution: Do not puncture or treat an unknown container as ordinary recycling.

materials.label: paper
materials.name: Paper
materials.action: Keep paper dry and free of food.
steps: Separate clean, dry paper from food and liquid waste.
Ask your collector about coated paper, receipts, tissues and soiled paper; they may need another route.
materials.caution: The model cannot reliably identify coatings or contamination.

materials.label: plastic
materials.name: Plastic
materials.action: Match the item to your local accepted list.
steps: Check whether the item’s shape and plastic type are accepted locally.
Empty accepted containers; follow collection instructions for cleaning and caps.
Keep bags, films and mixed-material packaging out of a collection stream unless explicitly accepted.
materials.caution: A resin code or recycling symbol alone does not establish local acceptance.

materials.label: trash
materials.name: Trash
materials.description: A broad residual category in TrashNet
materials.action: Pause and identify the item manually.
steps: Inspect the item and check local collection guidance before choosing a disposal route.
Separate batteries, electronics, chemicals, medical waste and other items needing special collection.
Use residual waste collection only when suitable under your local rules.
materials.caution: Trash is a broad, less reliable class. This prediction is not a safe-disposal decision.

local_rule: Recycling acceptance depends on your local collection rules and the item’s condition. A predicted material is not proof that an item is recyclable or safe to dispose of.
score_note: An uncalibrated model score, not a probability that the prediction is correct.
